results.evidence: The Carrie Glacier lies in the peak's northeast cirque, flowing north-northeast from about 6,800 ft, while the standard ascent climbs the southwest ridge via the Catwalk. The row mixes both: its approach and face follow the SW-ridge line while beta/itinerary describe a NE glacier entry. No source documents this glacier variation as a climbing line, so the correct aspect/face cannot be settled; the row's own corrections note flags the same identity problem.
